metadataSuggestion.title: Metadata suggestion
metadataSuggestion.summary: A proposed value for a missing Woo field, for a person to accept or reject
metadataSuggestion.description: When a publication lacks its information category, publisher organisation or handling type, OpenCatalogi proposes a value from data the instance already holds (source rules) or, on request, from Hermiq (source hermiq). Nothing is written to the publication until a person who may update it accepts the suggestion (woo-metadata-suggestions REQ-WMS-001, REQ-WMS-003).

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: The publication the value is proposed for.

field.title: Field
field.description: The publication field the value is proposed for.

value.title: Value
value.description: The proposed value, as the publication field stores it.

valueLabel.title: Value label
valueLabel.description: The proposed value as an editor reads it.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the proposal came from: the rules floor, or Hermiq on an editor's request.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why this value is proposed, in a sentence an editor can check.

status.title: Status
status.description: Pending until a person accepts or rejects it.

decidedBy.title: Decided by
decidedBy.description: The user who accepted or rejected the suggestion.

decidedAt.title: Decided at
decidedAt.description: When the suggestion was accepted or rejected.

accept.label: Accept
accept.description: Write the value to the publication.

pendingByPublication.description: Pending suggestions per publication, read by the suggestions widget header.
